mission: Implement message filtering, acknowledgments, and batching

task_1_filtering_subscription.details: Already implemented by prior wave in bus.py. Verified working: subscribe() method on BusReader accepts msg_types, priority_min, team_filter. poll() applies fast regex pre-filter (_quick_match) on raw bytes before JSON decode, skipping non-matching lines. Post-decode validation catches regex false positives.
features: BusReader.subscribe(msg_types, priority_min, team_filter)
Fast regex pre-filter on raw bytes (_quick_match) avoids JSON decode for non-matching lines
Post-decode validation catches regex false positives
priority field on Message dataclass (default=0)
BusWriter.publish() accepts optional priority parameter

task_2_ack_protocol.description: End-to-end acknowledgment protocol with timeout and retry
features: AckProtocol class wrapping BusWriter + BusReader
send_with_ack() - blocking send with timeout, polls for ack
send_no_wait() - non-blocking tracked send for async workflows
ack() - sends ack message with in_reply_to referencing original
process_incoming_acks() - batch process ack messages from poll
get_unacked(older_than) - query messages not acked within timeout
retry_unacked(max_retries) - re-publish unacked messages with retry tracking
get_stats() - summary of pending/acked/failed counts
cleanup(older_than) - remove old acked/failed entries
SQLite WAL mode with SQLITE_BUSY retry (SOP-034 compliant)
Thread-safe with threading.Lock

task_3_batching_priority_lanes.description: Message batching and priority lane system
task_3_batching_priority_lanes.details: Already implemented by prior wave in bus.py. Verified working: publish_batch() groups by priority lane, chunks to stay under 4096-byte POSIX limit, atomic fd writes. Priority >= 5 routes to {channel}_urgent.jsonl. BusReader.poll() checks urgent lane first.
features: BusWriter.publish_batch(channel, messages) - atomic multi-message append
Batch chunking respects 4096-byte POSIX atomic write limit
Priority >= 5 routes to {channel}_urgent.jsonl (fast lane)
Normal messages go to {channel}.jsonl
BusReader.poll() checks urgent lane first, then normal lane
Urgent lane has separate offset tracking for persistence

test_cases: Filtered poll (msg_types + priority_min) returns only matching
Batch publish writes 10 messages, all readable
Priority lane separation (priority>=5 in urgent file)
Ack protocol: send_no_wait tracks in SQLite
Ack protocol: get_unacked returns pending messages
Ack protocol: ack() sends ack message with in_reply_to
Ack protocol: process_incoming_acks marks messages acked
Ack protocol: get_stats returns correct counts
